CAUSE: `subprocess.run(..., text=True, capture_output=True)` in `app.merge_test_gate.run_pytest` normally returns decoded strings, but `subprocess.TimeoutExpired.stdout` and `.stderr` may still be bytes. The timeout handler concatenates them before checking their type, so mixed `str` and `bytes` raise `TypeError`; the later decode is never reached. This also occurs in `app.acceptance`’s timeout handler.

Fix: normalize each captured stream to text before concatenating, decoding bytes with `errors="replace"`, then truncate the result.
